title.narrative: SUPPORT HEALTH SECTOR STRATEGIC PLAN FIVE (HSSPV) MID-TERM REVIEW

description.narrative: Support to the Health Sector Strategic Plan Five (HSSP V) Mid-term review.HSSP V is the Tanzania's guiding framework for the detailed planning and implementation of activities by health sector stakeholders at all levels. HSSP V focuses on the achievement of the sustainable development goals especially SDG 3: Ensure healthy lives and wellbeing for all at all ages, as well as other SDGs with an impact on health. The vision of HSSP V is to have a healthy and prosperous society that contributes fully to the development of individuals and the country. It aims for the health sector to provide sustainable health services with standards that are acceptable to all citizens without financial constraints, based on geographical and gender equity (Universal Health Coverage).The MTR of the HSSP V will assess the progress of implementation and suggest corrective measures for the remaining lifespan of the plan. It will also inform development of the next strategic plan (HSSP VI).
